title: Mahesh Chandra @ Mahesh Singh v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Disposed; clause 6.5 representation to be decided; coercive action stayed
headnote: A writ seeking correction of electricity bills was disposed of by directing respondent no. 2 to decide the petitioner's representation dated 3 February 2023, treating it as one under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, by a speaking order within six weeks, with no coercive action in the meantime.
facts: Mahesh Chandra, also known as Mahesh Singh, sought a mandamus directing the respondents to correct electricity bills issued to him. He had already filed a representation dated 3 February 2023. Counsel for the respondent Electricity Department stated that the representation could be treated as one under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 and would be decided by the competent authority.

holding_units.holding: The petition was disposed of on the Electricity Department's statement that the representation dated 3 February 2023 could be treated as one under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Respondent no. 2 was directed to decide it by a speaking order within six weeks of receipt of a true attested copy of the order, and not to take any coercive action against the petitioner in the meantime. The Court did not itself correct the bills.

principle_tags.application: Respondent no. 2 was directed to decide the petitioner's pending representation dated 3 February 2023 by a speaking order within six weeks of receiving a true attested copy of the order.

The Court accepted that the petitioner's representation seeking correction of electricity bills could be treated as a representation under clause 6.5 and decided by the competent authority, and disposed of the writ on that basis.
Instead of correcting the bills in writ jurisdiction, the Court relegated the dispute to a decision of the clause 6.5 representation and restrained coercive action only until that decision.

not_decided.point: Whether the electricity bills issued to the petitioner require correction
not_decided.note: Left to respondent no. 2 to decide the representation dated 3 February 2023 by a speaking order.
